welcome.title: Speak without fear.
welcome.blurb: Tell someone what happened and follow your case without giving your name.
welcome.promise1Detail: No address is kept with your report, and there is no account to find.
welcome.promise2Detail: Location and camera details are removed on this phone before sending.
welcome.promise3Detail: You are never asked who you are. Nothing about you can be handed over.
welcome.promise4Detail: The code that follows your case is created on this phone, not by us.
welcome.helpNote: Hotlines & support connects to EWLA 7711 and other support lines, not police.
more.title: More
more.blurb: Optional tools. The main buttons stay on Home.
more.howDetail: What happens if you send a report.
more.planDetail: A private list that stays on this phone.
more.helpSomeoneDetail: What to say, and what not to take over.
more.privacyDetail: What a report carries, and what it does not.
more.languageDetail: English and Amharic are ready. Four more are listed.
more.accountDetail: A name for this space. Not your real name.
more.duressDetail: A number to text if you shake this phone.
crisis.quiet: It sounds like things are really hard right now. Want to see some support options?
offline.banner: You are offline right now. Turn on mobile data when you are ready to send.
offline.periodicNote: Reminders are periodic, not instant. This phone cannot always tell the moment data drops.
i18n.title: Language
i18n.toast: {name} support is coming soon. For now the app will stay in {current}.
account.title: A name for this space
account.blurb: Your phone or email stays private. It is never shown to other users or police.
account.handleHint: Never shown on posts or reports
duress.title: Trusted alert
duress.blurb: While you are safe, add one number. A hard shake while Kasat is open starts a 20-second window. If you do not cancel, a plain SMS is offered to that number with a maps link. This uses cell signal, not Wi-Fi.
duress.name: What to call them
duress.phase2: Shake only works while this app is open. Detection from a locked screen is not in this version.
receipt.queuedBody: There was no connection, so nothing left yet. It will send on its own when this phone is back online.
